public.heroTitle: Get paid to spread the word
public.heroSubtitle: Earn 25% of the fees from every merchant you refer — for a full 12 months. Take it as fee credit or cash out in USDT (TRC-20).
public.noCap: No cap on referrals. The more businesses you bring, the more you earn.
public.exampleBody: Refer a store doing $50,000/month. At ~1.5% in fees that's about $750/month — you earn 25% ≈ $187 every month, for a year.
public.exampleNote: Illustrative only — your earnings depend on your referrals' real volume and fees.

faq.a: 25% of the platform fees each merchant you refer generates, for 12 months. There's no limit on how many people you refer.
When a merchant you referred takes their first $100+ payment within 90 days of signing up — that opens your 12-month window.
Automatically as fee credit on your own Dynopay fees, or cash out to a USDT (TRC-20) wallet you choose.
